text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The skincare shelves really are 
overflowing with sparkly feminine charm...

text_block_list.name: Cosmetics Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here you go~♪ If you're looking for our 
most popular item, this glitter gel will 
make your skin super sparkly and shiny~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I, is dat so... I see, I see. Umm, 
well~~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Pathetic. In the end, I just ran away 
with my tail between my legs.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just buy it online... Then 
again, I won't know how it feels to use.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Sparkly things really are... my 
Achilles' heel...

To improve her rough skin, Nice Nature 
took on the dazzling challenge...
